content.bridge_context: We start our journey into the past by learning how historians and archaeologists find out about events that happened thousands of years ago.

units.title: Sources of History
units.explanation: We learn about the past through Manuscripts (handwritten books), Inscriptions (writings on hard surfaces like stone), and Archaeological finds (objects, pots, bones).
units.dual_language_instruction: Identify the difference between a book and a stone carving. / एक किताब और पत्थर की नक्काशी के बीच अंतर पहचानें।

units.title: Dates and Geography
units.explanation: History uses dates like BC/BCE (Before Christ) and AD/CE (Anno Domini). Geography (rivers, mountains) determined where early people lived.
units.dual_language_instruction: Look at the map of the Indian subcontinent. Find the River Indus. / भारतीय उपमहाद्वीप के मानचित्र को देखें। सिंधु नदी खोजें।
